definitions.gloss: exhibitor; seller; person who lists an item
definitions.explanation: A person or company that puts something up at an exhibition, a fair, an auction, or (most often today) an online marketplace or flea-market app. The person on the other side is the buyer, {購入者|こうにゅうしゃ} or {落札者|らくさつしゃ}.

examples.japanese: {出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}した→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent a question to the seller.

examples.japanese: ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Shipping is paid by the seller.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展示会|てんじかい}→展示会：21869_tenjikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{百社|ひゃくしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧{出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: On the first day of the trade show, more than a hundred exhibitors gathered from all over the country.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{出品|しゅっぴん}→出品：11726_shuppin⟧ (putting an item up for display or sale) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). On flea-market apps and auction sites it is the standard word for the seller, and it appears constantly in their rules and reviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact the seller
- {出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧: the seller's rating
- {出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧: (shipping) paid by the seller
- {出品者|しゅっぴんしゃ}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of exhibitors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{売|う}り{手|て}→売り手：24769_urite⟧: seller — the general word for the selling side in any deal
- {販売者|はんばいしゃ}: seller; vendor — a person or business that sells goods; the general word
